additional_info.subject: WAN Port Failure
additional_info.body:
Dear Luis-Miguel,
Thank you for your follow-up.
Issue description:
WAN port was not lighting up
on the router
Laptop was connected
to the WAN port -
no light, no connection
Via the
web interface
, the
WAN port showed as down
External LAN connection was also tested
- no improvement
Resolution:
The issue was
resolved by replacing the router
.
The defective router will be sent to you as per standard
147_ST_41
for supplier analysis.
The ticket can now be closed
.
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
Laurenz Stelzl
